name: Rylen
source: Together with Kiana, he leads the Sunsets. He’s the cool-headed one in this relationship. Born to a rich family, he now uses his stellar education and connections to grow a crime empire. Everything was going well until Nova and her gang decided to start a war... He wants to negotiate peace, but you can only negotiate with Nova on your knees, and it’s something Kiana would never accept.
